title: Artist discography span
statementMd:
For each artist with albums show first and last album year and the span in years. Ties are fine; list all.

Expected columns: `name`, `first_album`, `last_album`, `span`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT ar.name, MIN(al.release_year) AS first_album, MAX(al.release_year) AS last_album, MAX(al.release_year) - MIN(al.release_year) AS span FROM artists ar JOIN albums al ON al.artist_id = ar.id GROUP BY ar.id, ar.name;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
